decisions.decision: Use parish wine, warm gold, and paper cream with restrained ceremonial motifs.
decisions.reason: Creates a dignified celebration identity while keeping schedules and forms readable.

decisions.decision: Use Fraunces for editorial display type and DM Sans for interface copy.
decisions.reason: Balances heritage character with practical readability.

decisions.decision: Use the official parish logo for public navigation and the committee logo for the hero and committee workspace.
decisions.reason: Makes ownership clear while keeping both identities visible in their appropriate contexts.

decisions.decision: Use a fixed, horizontally scrollable mobile committee navigation with five labeled actions visible at a time.
decisions.reason: Keeps the workspace sections, public-site link, and sign-out action reachable without taking vertical space from admin content.

decisions.decision: Present mobile activity records as bordered cards with title/status first, followed by type, grouped schedule and venue metadata, and a separated action row.
decisions.reason: Prevents table-grid collisions on narrow screens and makes schedule records easy to scan and operate.

decisions.decision: Use a balanced six-column desktop runner table and convert each mobile registration into a structured card with grouped runner, race, fee, status, and action regions.
decisions.reason: Keeps review actions readable on desktop while making dense registration records scannable on phones.

decisions.decision: Render mobile race timing results as medal-accented runner cards with a prominent bib/name header and icon-backed category, division, age, and official-time tiles.
decisions.reason: Matches the selected race-result visual direction while preserving accurate ranks and responsive 2-by-2 stat tiles on narrow phones.

decisions.decision: Present mobile user administration as compact identity cards with contact icons, right-aligned role/status badges, and a separated action row.
decisions.reason: Matches the selected Users & Staff reference and makes account management scannable on phones without changing the desktop table.

decisions.decision: Use a grouped responsive administrator modal for account details, staff roles, suspension, and optional password reset, with destructive user deletion kept outside the editor.
decisions.reason: Makes complete account administration understandable while clearly separating irreversible actions.

decisions.decision: Use icon-only Edit and Delete controls in the Users & Staff list, with accessible labels and tooltips, and order all accounts by administrator, staff, then runner.
decisions.reason: Keeps the action column compact on every screen while placing the highest-access accounts first.

decisions.decision: Create staff accounts through the administrator workspace using the same grouped modal language as account editing, then show temporary credentials once for secure handoff.
decisions.reason: There is no public staff sign-up, so account creation, profile entry, and role assignment must be one clear protected workflow.

decisions.decision: Use the organizer-provided parish floral artwork as the responsive landing hero visual, with a feathered radial edge and an optimized WebP source plus PNG fallback.
decisions.reason: Carries the updated parish identity into the most prominent public section without introducing a hard square edge or excessive image weight.

decisions.decision: Keep the public footer identity full-width and show Explore and Information as two link columns on mobile, with a centered copyright line.
decisions.reason: Preserves the parish and committee identity while making the requested footer links faster to scan without adding vertical length.

decisions.decision: Present gallery content as separate photo and video collections, split into current and previous celebrations, with Facebook-style multi-item previews and an accessible full-screen viewer.
decisions.reason: Lets public visitors browse large year-based archives quickly while giving administrators clear collection, publication, photo-upload, and YouTube-video workflows.

decisions.decision: Use the parish hero artwork as the favicon and installed-app icon, with a restrained burgundy install invitation and platform-specific instructions.
decisions.reason: Creates consistent browser, home-screen, and desktop identity while respecting the different installation capabilities of Android, iOS, and desktop browsers.

decisions.decision: Use one auditable finance cashbook with Overall, Sinoog Festival, Sinoog Run, and General allocation views; dynamic cash-inflow and expense forms; and responsive ledger cards.
decisions.reason: Gives administrators one reliable source for balances, counterparties, payment modes, purposes, recorders, void history, and reporting exports without fragmenting financial records.

decisions.decision: Use paper-cream segmented filter groups with wine active states for public schedules and announcements, arranged as equal columns on desktop and balanced two-column grids on mobile.
decisions.reason: Makes the related choices read as one modern control, preserves large touch targets, and prevents the uneven loose-pill wrapping shown on narrow screens.

decisions.decision: Carry subtle bamboo silhouettes through the desktop landing hero and the mobile ceremonial parish panel, with separated parish, festival, and acclamation typography plus restrained floating motion on the mobile emblem.
decisions.reason: Creates a consistent landing identity that reflects the local tradition that the Holy Child image was retrieved from bamboo, preserves reduced-motion accessibility, and keeps the devotional content visually dominant.

decisions.decision: Use outlined M3 cards for comparable Sinoog Run categories, filled tonal cards for supporting race information, and the shared native-dialog primitive for the singlet size guide.
decisions.reason: Makes fees, kit inclusions, registration state, and route information easy to compare while preserving the existing run data and improving responsive and keyboard accessibility.

decisions.decision: Keep the ceremonial Home hero and bamboo artwork as a branded exception, then use filled tonal milestone and schedule cards with outlined sponsor and map surfaces below it.
decisions.reason: Preserves the parish's distinct devotional identity while giving the data-heavy landing content a consistent Material 3 hierarchy and responsive rhythm.
